dogecoin.text: @CoinbaseSupport Would you please ask the powers that be, to add a Dogecoin wallet to the retail site? All of us lowly retail customers need a safe wallet to hold Dogecoin, even if we aren't allowed to trade it. Please consider doing so now, not months down the line?

@coinbase 
How about just adding a holding account function for Dogecoin, on the original coinbase site?  Us lowly retail peeps need a safe wallet too!
